articles.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
articles.snippet: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

articles.title: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
articles.snippet: French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases involving kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft in seven months. What makes France such a hotspot?

articles.title: Cantor Fitzgerald faces Senate Democrat’s questions over Tether ties
articles.snippet: The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.

articles.title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
articles.snippet: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

articles.title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced to 40 Years Over $430M Dark Web Bazaar
articles.snippet: Raheim Hamilton forfeited some 1,230 BTC. His co-creator Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is due to be sentenced this month.
